Title: Azure Stream Analytics—Debug queries using job diagram in Visual Studio Code is now available

Body.Content:
A new feature in Visual Studio Code that enables you to debug Azure Stream Analytics queries using job diagram is now available.

The Visual Studio Code extension for Azure Stream Analytics integrates job diagrams, metrics, diagnostic logs, and intermediate results to help you quickly isolate the source of a problem. The job diagram shows how data flows from input sources, like Event Hub or IoT Hub, through multiple query steps to output sinks. Each query step is mapped to a temporary result set defined in the script using a WITH statement. View the data as well as metrics of each query step in each intermediate result set to find the source of an issue.

Key features

  • View job topology, navigate code and view intermediate result set
  • View metrics
  • View logs
  • Job summary

Follow the instructions to try it today.
